rows.grounds: compound denoting the breadth or diameter of the linga, serving as the reference measure
compound indicating one part out of eight, i.e. one eighth
term indicating extent or measure; exact derivation uncertain in this form
compound naming the base stone associated with the Drāviḍa type of linga

items.question: What proportion of the linga diameter determines the Drāviḍa ground stone?
premises: The linga diameter provides the reference measure.
One eighth part of that measure is specified.
This specification applies to the Drāviḍa ground stone.
items.inference: The Drāviḍa ground stone is defined as one eighth of the linga diameter.
uncertainties: The precise grammatical analysis and derivation of 'ravātā' are unclear.
items.plain_english: For the Drāviḍa type, the ground stone measures one eighth of the linga's diameter.
